title: Arithmetic expression evaluator (precedence, parens, unary minus)

agent.requirement: Implement `evaluate(src: string): number` that evaluates an arithmetic expression string. Support binary + - * / with correct precedence (* and / bind tighter than + and -) and left-associativity, parentheses including nesting, unary minus/plus including right after an operator (e.g. 3*-2 === -6), decimal numbers, and arbitrary whitespace. Throw on division by zero, malformed input (e.g. '2+'), and invalid characters (e.g. '2#3').
